name: After recital J
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Ja. whereas the Commission issued a communication on a European Democracy Shield which is intended to prevent and protect the EU against interference; whereas extremist groups are increasingly using online platforms and social media to reach and influence young people, encouraging them to engage with or join such organisations; whereas this phenomenon may be further reinforced through the spread of extremist narratives and recruitment efforts in educational environments;
